config.target: Within each training signal date, strict eligible finite y_excess_5d samples only: relevance=min(9,floor(10*(average_rank(y)-0.5)/n)). Ties keep equal relevance. All tied returns have one relevance and no pairwise ranking signal. No global quantile estimates or future-period labels.
config.groups: Sort by signal_date and PERMNO before masking; each contiguous signal date is one query. Missing/unverified or boundary-crossing targets excluded before computing relevance. Inference still covers all eligible stocks regardless of target availability.
config.shared_fixed: All other estimator settings copied from frozen round2 lightgbm_fixed, including 100 trees, min_child_samples=500, learning_rate=.03, L2=1, seed=20261107. No early stopping.
config.preprocessing: Reuse exact round2 per-window original/enhanced LightGBM preprocessing states and saved development feature snapshot; do not fit new transforms.
config.selection: Equal weight mean across the two windows of equal-date Rank IC against continuous y_excess_5d; choose separately for original/enhanced features; exact ties choose lower candidate index. Save selection before portfolio evaluation.
config.diagnostics: NDCG at ceil(n/10) with linear relevance and predicted ties ordered by PERMNO; top-decile continuous label mean on eligible scored stocks, then strict-label filtering; yearly IC; matched-leaf comparisons with saved round2 regression results. NDCG and portfolio returns never select candidates.
config.portfolio: 2020-2021 only; replay selected window2 rankers under original top-decile and unchanged round1 constrained rules. Compare to saved round2 portfolios without retraining/replaying regression models.
config.interpretation: Development and selection diagnostics, not independent confirmation. This experiment changes both loss and discrete target representation; it cannot isolate pure loss effect. No 2022-2025 performance reads or model selection.

parent.boundary: Training label_end_date must not exceed train end; preprocessing fitted on training only. Equal weight per evaluation date, then equal weight per window.
parent.selection: Mean Rank IC across two windows; exact ties choose simpler/earlier fixed configuration. Ranking diagnostics do not create additional tuning objectives.
parent.unseen_evaluation: New period must be named and frozen before accessing its research data; 2022-2025 cannot be reused as unseen test. No new-period data read in round 1.
parent.optimizer: Maximize same-date percentile score by linear programming across all signal-eligible stocks. Full investment; no turnover penalty or covariance optimization in round 1. SIC two-digit industry; unknown is separate. Missing beta/vol imputed with contemporaneous universe median; abort if column entirely missing. Infeasible/failed solve aborts, never relaxes based on performance.

execution.timing: every fifth signal date, next-close execution
execution.exceptions: existing approved OTC quote proxy and CVR exclusion unchanged

evaluation.primary: Paired change in annualized mean daily net active return versus universe EW

parent.scope: Constraints apply to signal targets. Fees, unavailable securities, inherited positions and between-rebalance drift may change realized exposures; report execution deviations. Industry histories are effective-dated CRSP SIC, not guaranteed unrevised point-in-time releases. This is a risk-controlled observational experiment, not causal attribution.

context_features.industry_mom20: Same signal-date eligible industry mean momentum_20; fewer than 5 finite observations or Unknown industry falls back to universe mean
context_features.industry_rank20: Average-tie rank of momentum_20 within eligible industry: (rank-.5)/n-.5; fewer than 5 finite observations or Unknown falls back to universe rank
context_features.universe_mean_mom20: Equal weight mean of finite momentum_20 among signal-eligible stocks
context_features.universe_breadth20: Fraction of finite eligible momentum_20 strictly above zero
context_features.universe_dispersion20: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of eligible momentum_20

context.population: Signal-eligible population only, including stocks whose future label is missing. Finite observations only; no target information. Industry mean includes self. These universe proxies are not an external market index.
context.preprocessing: Ridge: original and added columns use training-only .005/.995 clipping, median fill and population scaling. LightGBM: original 21 use centered same-date cross-sectional ranks then existing training median/scaling; added 12 use raw training-only clipping/fill/scaling, preserving common market context and interactions. No label normalization.
context.selection: Parent two-window equal-weight mean Rank IC, ties choose first grid entry; choose independently within four designs. Persist every candidate; reuse existing fitted candidates for evaluation and portfolios, no refit.
context.portfolio_scope: 2020-2021 only, verified corporate action/settlement ledger; original top-decile and round1 constrained portfolios. 2019 prediction metrics only. No portfolio metric used for selection.
